svg.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.title: HelpYou Mortgage proposed logical topology
svg.text: Brisbane head office (two floors) and Cairns branch. VLAN IDs and subnets follow section 5; link speeds are the design targets from section 6.
1 GbE to each core; FW-HQ .1, core stack .2
Core stack = one logical switch (front-panel stack)
VLAN gateways (.1 of each subnet) on the stack; mgmt SVI 192.168.120.1
2 x 10 Gbps to cores + 1 GbE to DMZ
2 x 10 Gbps to cores + 1 GbE to DMZ
Server VLANs (gateways .1 on the core stack):
Each core uses all 12 ports: 6 access uplinks, 2 host links, 1 NAS link,
2 stack links and 1 firewall transit link.
Hyper-V Replica copies VMs between the hosts every 15 minutes; the NAS is
the backup target only. Both hosts carry a 1 GbE port to the DMZ switch.
Remote-access VPN with MFA also terminates on FW-HQ.
1 GbE from each host (SMTP-GW virtual switch)
Floor 1: ASW-1 to ASW-3, 144 x 1 Gbps PoE+ ports
VLANs served (gateways .1 on the core stack unless noted):
* guest gateway on FW-HQ; guests are internet-only.
35 desks: PC on a 1 Gbps port, phone on its own PoE port.
Access ports 1 Gbps; uplinks 2 x 10 Gbps per switch.
Floor 2: ASW-4 to ASW-6, 144 x 1 Gbps PoE+ ports
VLANs served (gateways .1 on the core stack unless noted):
* guest gateway on FW-HQ; guests are internet-only.
35 desks: PC on a 1 Gbps port, phone on its own PoE port.
Access ports 1 Gbps; uplinks 2 x 10 Gbps per switch.
FW-HQ to FW-BR over both ISP services; only permitted branch-to-server flows
8 staff; one access switch, one AP and
only through the VPN policy on FW-HQ.
Single ISP service and single firewall
per site are accepted residual risks.
Every access switch, host and the NAS has one 10 Gbps link to CORE 1 and one to CORE 2. Addresses written .x.y are inside 192.168.x.0 (Brisbane).
